reference_policy: Approved design reference: Choi Dongmin front.png only (reviews/STATUS.md S1–S15). Attempt 5 for the sea-gate key is a targeted edit of this chat's own candidate, explicitly labelled an edit target. No outside images, old art or files from a _rejects folder were used as design inputs.

visual_qa.known_faults: Sea-gate scale markers too large after five attempts.

images.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production location reference for an original Korean action webtoon. Generate ONE landscape image, exactly 1536×1024 PNG, full canvas edge to edge, no border, no inset, no collage. Recipe: establish; this is a fully drawn location key with full architectural detail in clean ink and opaque cel planes, still lower contrast than the tiny scale figures. Leave a calm upper area naturally within the scene. One coherent camera, believable construction and real scale; full human proportions, crop rather than compress bodies. Any visible signs, labels, packages and logos are completely blank; ALL electronic screens are solid flat #00FF00 without glyphs. Small ordinary anonymous people are only scale markers unless explicitly named.

Dusk on a dark Han River overpass. Main subject is the EMPTY DRIVER'S SEAT and cockpit of an unbranded black sports coupe, left-hand-drive. Camera at 1.25 m above road, at the open passenger-side doorway, looking diagonally across to the driver's seat, steering wheel at vehicle-left, matte black dash, and windscreen. Large river and bridge spans visible BELOW through windows beyond the guard rail; distant city lights just turning on. A small phone lies securely on the dashboard with solid green screen; dashboard display likewise solid green, no gauge letters or numbers. Named key light: muted grey-violet dusk through windscreen, with restrained warm sodium bridge lamps outside, not a saturated sci-fi cabin. Outside through the windscreen ONE very tiny anonymous adult is 25 m ahead on the overpass pedestrian path, standing with both feet on pavement beside a 1.1 m guardrail. Keep car interior dominant and clearly legible, no woman or named character in seat; car about 1.5 m tall, seats human-sized, credible perspective and connected cabin geometry.

No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.

attempts.review: Empty left-hand-drive cockpit, parked over river, correct dusk, plain screens, small grounded scale figure; no text or branding.
